harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node3->node4 TCP/23 traffic to route through node1 (VyOS, permits+logs) then node2 (OPNsense, refuses+logs), captured a matching log pair proving the drop point at node2, and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart/recovery protocol on all four nodes.
actions_performed: Surveyed all 4 nodes: node1=VyOS, node2=OPNsense/FreeBSD, node3/node4=Ubuntu 16.04, all sharing flat network 10.100.124.0/24 with platform gateway .1
Added a static host route on node3 (10.100.124.13/32 via node1 10.100.124.10) to force node3->node4:23 traffic through node1 first

On node1 (VyOS): added protocols static route 10.100.124.13/32 next-hop 10.100.124.11 (node2), plus firewall ipv4 forward filter rule 10 (action accept, log enabled) matching src 10.100.124.12 dst 10.100.124.13 tcp/23; committed and saved to config.boot

On node2 (OPNsense): inserted a reject+log filter rule (interface lan, protocol tcp, src 10.100.124.12, dst 10.100.124.13:23) ahead of the default allow-lan-any rule via config.xml XML surgery, then ran configctl filter reload
Ran a telnet-port connection attempt from node3 to node4 and confirmed 'Connection refused' at node2, never reaching node4

Correlated one attempt's log pair by matching IP ID and TCP source port between node1's kernel ACCEPT log ([ipv4-FWD-filter-10-A]) and node2's pf BLOCK/filterlog entry, proving the identical packet was permitted+logged at node1 and refused+logged at node2

Executed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured boot_id/kern.boottime plus service/config health baselines on every node, safely rebooted node1, node2, node3, node4 strictly one at a time, polled each until exec access returned, verified changed boot identity for every node, and confirmed recovered configuration/services/routes on each (route restored on node3 since it was a live-only entry; VyOS and OPNsense rules persisted automatically)
Re-ran the node3->node4 attempt after all four restarts and reconfirmed a fresh matching accept/reject log pair (IP ID 13402, sport 32982) end-to-end post-recovery

evidence.requirement: node1 permits and logs the traffic
evidence.summary: VyOS forward-filter rule 10 (protocol tcp, src 10.100.124.12, dst 10.100.124.13:23, action accept, log enabled) committed and saved on node1

evidence.requirement: node2 refuses and logs the traffic
evidence.summary: OPNsense config.xml gained a reject+log rule on lan for tcp src 10.100.124.12 dst 10.100.124.13:23, compiled by pf as 'block return in log quick' (sends RST), placed ahead of default allow-lan rule

evidence.requirement: one attempt from node3 produces a matched accept/refuse log pair showing traffic stopped at node2
evidence.summary: nc attempt from node3 got 'Connection refused'; node1 kernel log shows ACCEPT for IP ID=27716 SRC=10.100.124.12 DST=10.100.124.13 SPT=53942 DPT=23 SYN; node2 filterlog shows BLOCK for the identical IP ID=27716, same 4-tuple and SYN flag -- same packet permitted at node1, refused at node2

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e98d9010...; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; boot_id changed to f2f8eb05...; forwarding, static route and firewall rule confirmed recovered from config.boot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline kern.boottime sec=1788675595; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot kern.boottime sec=1788675980 (changed); pf reject rule and net.inet.ip.forwarding=1 confirmed intact after reload

evidence.requirement: end-to-end functional proof immediately after node1/node2 restarts
evidence.summary: Fresh nc attempt from node3 refused; matching IP ID 60586 / sport 53944 found in both node1 accept log and node2 block log post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id f6f9440e...; reboot acknowledged; connection-refused observed mid-reboot; boot_id changed to c2f2ade4...; SSH active and static route to node4 restored post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 2ba78175...; reboot acknowledged; connection-refused observed mid-reboot; boot_id changed to 1a8bf726...; SSH active and network interfaces up post-reboot

evidence.requirement: final full-cluster post-restart proof of the task outcome
evidence.summary: After all 4 nodes restarted, a new node3 attempt was refused; matching IP ID 13402 / sport 32982 found in both node1's accept log and node2's block log, reconfirming the permit-then-refuse behavior end-to-end

attempts.summary: Configured node3->node4 TCP/23 traffic to route through node1 (VyOS, permits+logs) then node2 (OPNsense, refuses+logs), captured a matching log pair proving the drop point at node2, and completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart/recovery protocol on all four nodes.
